name: Cybersecurity Engineer
summary: Hardens systems and applications against threats through secure design reviews, controls, monitoring, and response.
whatTheyDo: Assess risks, implement security controls, support secure SDLC, and investigate suspicious activity depending on team focus.
midExpectations: Own AppSec or infra security domains
careerTransitions: Can specialize into AppSec, cloud security, or GRC
bangladeshNotes: Dedicated Cybersecurity Engineer openings exist but are fewer than general software roles on broad job boards. Security skills are also embedded in senior software/fintech ads (e.g. OWASP expectations in some technical lead postings). Regulated fintech and payments employers may emphasize compliance and secure SDLC. Titles vary (Security Engineer, SOC, IT Security). Certifications may be preferred but are not verified as universal requirements.
experienceExpectations: Senior security roles typically expect prior IT/software experience; junior paths may start via SOC or secure coding in engineering teams.
